top_signals.title: Plug Power Inks Electrolyzer Deal for Denmark Jet Fuel Project
top_signals.summary: Plug Power Inc., a supplier of hydrogen energy systems, has struck a deal to provide Arcadia eFuels with equipment for a Denmark project that aims to produce sustainable jet fuel.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Tech Stocks Get a Second Downgrade This Month on Growth Risks
top_signals.summary: Wells Fargo Investment Institute downgraded its view on the technology sector to neutral from favorable, citing lofty expectations and higher debt levels.
